purpose: Track prompt, taxonomy, and threshold changes systematically so pilot improvements are auditable and rerunnable.

prompt_refinements.change: Switched from 1-review-per-call to micro-batches of 5–8 reviews.
prompt_refinements.reason: Reduce Groq request overhead under free-tier RPM/TPD limits.

prompt_refinements.change: Added label sanitization when LLM puts barrier values in wrong fields.
prompt_refinements.reason: Schema validation failures were discarding otherwise usable enrichments.

prompt_refinements.change: Balanced insight drafting across discovery, behaviour, opportunity, and operational buckets.
prompt_refinements.reason: Complaint volume alone overweighted operational pain and underweighted discovery.

taxonomy_refinements.change: Extended taxonomy to v1.1.0 with discovery_trigger, category_exploration_barrier, experimentation_likelihood, required_trust_signal.
taxonomy_refinements.reason: Category-discovery analysis needed fields beyond generic complaint barriers.

taxonomy_refinements.change: Added backward-compatible inference from older enrichment labels.
taxonomy_refinements.reason: Avoid re-burning Groq quota to re-label already enriched reviews.

threshold_refinements.change: Daily enrichment cap default 130 reviews; RPM throttle 10.
threshold_refinements.reason: Stay under Groq free-tier token and request budgets.

threshold_refinements.change: Minimum cluster size 3; low-volume themes marked lower confidence.
Priority score combines evidence, segment size, strategic importance, actionability, confidence.
threshold_refinements.reason: Make recommendation ranking explicit and reviewable.

proposed_next_refinements.change: Fill and evaluate the Phase 2 gold set against Groq labels.
proposed_next_refinements.reason: Strengthen precision claims before operationalizing the agent.

proposed_next_refinements.change: Raise enrichment coverage above 50% of the cohort before publishing final discovery rankings.
proposed_next_refinements.reason: Current pilot is directional on a partial enriched sample.

proposed_next_refinements.change: Add eligibility rules for trust-based expansion experiments (e.g. recent clean order).
proposed_next_refinements.reason: Stakeholder feedback asked for clearer segment eligibility on primary metrics.
